Figures.caption: FIGURE 1 Illustration showing cisgene and intragene gene constructs. In cisgene, genes from the pool of sexually compatible individuals that include the promoter, introns, and terminator (A, B) . When using agrobacterium-mediated transformation, the cisgene is inserted within agrobacterium-derived T-DNA borders. Within the sexually compatible gene pool, intragenesis enables in vitro recombination of components isolated from several genes (A, C) . Furthermore, cDNA or gene fragments may be employed; introns are not necessary. Consequently, both silencing and expression intragenic constructions are possible ( Schouten et al., 2006a ).
